Notify.NoGM: A GM needs to be connected to change creatures you don't own.
Notify.ActionFailed: That didn't work. The console (F12) has the details.

Stances.NoneKnown: No stances known yet. Use Learn below, or drag stances from the Martial Stances folder of the Subclasses compendium.
Stances.DropHint: Drop out of your active stance
Stances.Stacked: More than one stance is active. Shift or drop to keep only one.
Stances.ShiftStress: Shift by marking a Stress (Flow State)
Stances.NothingToLearn: No more stances of your tier or lower to learn.
Stances.AtLimit: You know as many stances as your level allows (two, plus one per level after 1st).
Stances.RefocusHint: Once per rest, in a moment of calm: clear your Focus, roll a d6 for each point of Instinct and keep the highest
Stances.RefocusFlavor: Refocus: Focus equals the highest die
Stances.RefocusNone: {actor} refocuses, but with no Instinct dice to roll their Focus stays empty.
Stances.DropDamageChat: {actor} drops out of their stance after taking Severe damage or marking their last Hit Point.

Effect.new: Spend a Hope to negate Minor damage.

Lunar.RollHint: At the beginning of each session, roll a d6 to set this session's phase.
Lunar.AdvanceHint: Once per rest, spend a Hope to raise the die by one (a 6 becomes a 1).
Lunar.AdvanceChat: {actor} spends a Hope to turn the moon: {phase}.

Hex.None: No creature on this scene is hexed.
Hex.HexHint: Mark a Stress to Hex your targeted creatures (uses the feature's own action).
Hex.OverCap: {actor} now has {count} creatures hexed, more than their Spellcast trait allows ({cap}).

Warlock.AidHint: Spend a Favor: your Patron Die is added to your next action roll. Click again to cancel without a refund.
Warlock.AidChat: {actor} calls on {patron}: {die} joins their next action roll.
Warlock.TributeHint: Downtime move: show tribute to your patron and gain Favor equal to your Spellcast trait.
Warlock.TributeChat: {actor} shows tribute to their patron and gains {amount} Favor.
Warlock.NoTribute: Your Spellcast trait is 0 or less, so tribute gains no Favor.
Warlock.FuryHint: Spend a Favor: add a Patron Die per tier to your damage until you deal Severe damage or the scene ends.
Warlock.FuryChat: {actor} is imbued with their patron's fury: +{dice} damage until they deal Severe damage.
Warlock.FuryEndChat: {actor} dealt Severe damage; Patron's Fury ends.

Mark.None: No creature on this scene is Marked for Death.
Mark.MarkHint: Mark a Stress to mark your targeted creature (uses the feature's own action). The previous mark is cleared.
Mark.BonusHint: Turn on while you attack your marked target: the mark's dice are added to your damage rolls. Turns itself off when no mark remains.

Poison.BrewHint: Mark a Stress to place 1d4+1 tokens on the card. Unspent tokens clear on a long rest.
Poison.Hint: After a successful weapon attack, spend a token to afflict the target. Poisons with a system action are applied to your targets.
Poison.TwinFang: Twin Fang: against a target Marked for Death, spend another token for a second poison.

graveSpore.Name: Grave Spore
graveSpore.Text: The target must also mark a Stress.

leechWeed.Name: Leech Weed
leechWeed.Text: You deal an extra 1d6 damage on this attack.

midnightVine.Name: Midnight Vine
midnightVine.Text: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls until it marks a Stress to clear this condition.

blightSeed.Name: Blight Seed
blightSeed.Text: The target gains a −3 penalty to their damage thresholds until the end of the scene. This effect can't stack.

fearLeaf.Name: Fear Leaf
fearLeaf.Text: You deal extra damage equal to the result of your Fear Die on this attack.

corpseThorn.Name: Corpse Thorn
corpseThorn.Text: The target gains disadvantage on reaction rolls until the end of the scene.

Patterns.Hint: When either Duality Die shows this number, the system asks whether to gain a Hope or clear a Stress. You can change it on a long rest.

Unstoppable.Hint: The die starts at 1 and rises after each damage roll that deals Hit Points; past its maximum, Unstoppable ends.
Unstoppable.EndChat: {actor}'s Unstoppable Die passed its maximum; they are no longer Unstoppable.

ShowDrawer.Name: Show the class features drawer
ShowDrawer.Hint: A pull-out tab on the edge of character sheets with panels for the features below. Only for characters that have one of them. The automations keep working with the drawer hidden.

MartialStances.Name: Brawler: Martial Stances
MartialStances.Hint: Martial Artist panel: Focus track, known stances, one-click shifting (Focus, or Stress with Flow State), Refocus, the trait for Favored and learning stances from the compendium.

OneStance.Name: Brawler: one active stance
OneStance.Hint: Entering a stance (from the drawer or the stance's own action) drops the one you were in.

StanceDropOut.Name: Brawler: drop stance on Severe damage
StanceDropOut.Hint: Leave the active stance when the character takes Severe damage (3 or more Hit Points at once) or marks their last Hit Point. Needs Martial Stances on.

Favor.Name: Warlock: Favor and Patron Die
Favor.Hint: Favor track, patron name and sphere, Patron Die sized by level (d6, d8 from level 5) added to the next action roll for a Favor, the Tribute downtime move, and Patron's Fury dice added to damage until Severe damage is dealt.

LunarPhases.Name: Witch: Lunar Phases
LunarPhases.Hint: Roll the moon each session and turn on only the matching phase effect; spend a Hope to advance it. Also keeps the effects in step when the die is changed on the sheet.

Hexes.Name: Witch: Hex tracker
Hexes.Hint: Lists hexed creatures on the scene against your Spellcast limit, lets you lift hexes and warns when a new hex goes past the limit.

MarkedForDeath.Name: Assassin: Marked for Death
MarkedForDeath.Hint: Shows your marked creature and the right damage dice (tier × d4, d6 with Ambush, d8 with Backstab), with a switch that adds them to your damage.

OneMark.Name: Assassin: one mark at a time
OneMark.Hint: Marking a new creature clears the mark from the previous one. Needs Marked for Death on.

ToxicConcoctions.Name: Assassin: Toxic Concoctions
ToxicConcoctions.Hint: Poison token counter with Brew (mark a Stress, add 1d4+1) and one-click poisons that spend a token, including Leech Weed and Fear Leaf.

StrangePatterns.Name: Wizard: Strange Patterns number
StrangePatterns.Hint: Pick your Strange Patterns number from a list instead of rerolling the d12 on the sheet. The system itself handles the Hope or Stress when the number comes up.

Unstoppable.Name: Guardian: Unstoppable
Unstoppable.Hint: The Unstoppable Die starts at 1, rises after each damage roll that deals Hit Points (d4, d6 from level 5) and ends Unstoppable when it passes its maximum.
